units.english: The Seiitej is the High Houses' vessel of choice for transporting small amounts of cargo and passengers throughout Successor space. Though less spacious than a dedicated civilian freighter or transport vessel, it is much more durable while remaining fast and maneuverable. While these vessels support a relatively light armament (by the standards of the High Houses), their speed and flexible internals allow them to frequently serve as patrol craft as well.
units.raw: description `The Seiitej is the High Houses' vessel of choice for transporting small amounts of cargo and passengers throughout Successor space. Though less spacious than a dedicated civilian freighter or transport vessel, it is much more durable while remaining fast and maneuverable. units.english: Their lighter armor and smaller combat systems also make them significantly less expensive to manufacture than the High Houses' purpose-built warships, which contributes to their growing ubiquity.
units.raw: description "	Their lighter armor and smaller combat systems also make them significantly less expensive to manufacture than the High Houses' purpose-built warships, which contributes to their growing ubiquity."

units.english: The Successors have limited experience in making warships this small, and while their attempt at an interceptor is durable and sports a surprising amount of firepower for a ship of its size, it is also plagued with power and propulsion issues, as most of their standard technology is either too large or not powerful enough to yield effective combat performance at this scale. The result is a ship that ambitious pilots call a challenge and prudent captains call a deathtrap, but that continues to see use as a patrol and escort vessel because of its speed and heavy armament.

units.english: The Stolsaqra also has the distinction of being the only purpose-built warship manufactured by the High Houses that is made available to the general public, albeit with significantly downgraded systems compared to the military-exclusive model.
units.raw: description `	The Stolsaqra also has the distinction of being the only purpose-built warship manufactured by the High Houses that is made available to the general public, albeit with significantly downgraded systems compared to the military-exclusive model.`

units.english: The Successors' attempt at an interceptor is quite compact and sports a surprising amount of firepower for a ship of its size, though restrictive internal space leaves it plagued with power and propulsion issues if it is equipped to fully utilize its weapons capacity. While it is manufactured by the High Houses, the Stolsaqra is made available to the general Successor public, albeit with significantly downgraded systems compared to the military-exclusive model.

units.english: Blessed with the honor of being named with the Successor word for swiftness, the Veusade is designed for only one purpose: to carry eight drag cannons as close to an enemy ship's hull as possible.
units.raw: description `Blessed with the honor of being named with the Successor word for swiftness, the Veusade is designed for only one purpose: to carry eight drag cannons as close to an enemy ship's hull as possible.`

units.english: Vessels of this lineage earned renown in many of the conflicts between the Predecessors' High Houses, catching and killing ships many times their size and escaping before reinforcements could arrive. In the present, such a narrowly-focused design makes these vessels ill-suited for multipurpose use, but they are frequently seen as auxiliary or police craft, owing to their ability to rapidly intercept and immobilize fleeing ships.
